canary.title: Canary

live_model.description: The model ID the agent asks for

trusted.title: Trusted
trusted.description: What it returns is believed, and real values may be sent to it

AgentSystem.title: AgentSystem
AgentSystem.description: One system the agent reaches through the gateway, with the tools it offers.

side_effects.title: Side Effects
side_effects.description: False only for a tool its system declares read-only

mail_domains.title: Mail Domains
mail_domains.description: Mail whose recipients are all on these domains carries real values

previous.description: The request this one refines, when the last one added nothing

added.title: Added
added.description: The pattern added, by name. Empty when none was

AssistTurn.title: AssistTurn
AssistTurn.description: A request that added nothing, and what the admin was told about it.

ChatCompletionEnvelope.title: ChatCompletionEnvelope
ChatCompletionEnvelope.description:
An OpenAI chat completion, or one streamed chunk of it, plus the `aspida` fields.

When streaming, the first chunk carries `aspida` and the last one before `[DONE]` carries
`aspida_summary`; both have empty `choices`. Otherwise both arrive in the one response.

ChatCompletionRequest.title: ChatCompletionRequest
ChatCompletionRequest.description:
An OpenAI Chat Completions request. Every field is read before anything is forwarded;
one the gateway does not know is refused with a 400 that names it.

sent_unmasked.title: Sent Unmasked
sent_unmasked.description: The text reached the AI tool as written

EventOut.title: EventOut
EventOut.description: An event as analysts see it: team level, no user identity.

summary.title: Summary
summary.description: One plain sentence: what was found and what was done

Heatmap.title: Heatmap
Heatmap.description: `cells[i][j]` is the number of events from `teams[i]` carrying `data_types[j]`.

actions.title: Actions
actions.description: What the active policy would have done

lines.title: Lines
lines.description: Log lines read, not counting blank lines and comments

malformed.title: Malformed
malformed.description: Lines that could not be parsed and were skipped

matched.title: Matched
matched.description: Lines that went to a tool in the inventory

lines.description: Log lines read, not counting blank lines and comments

malformed.title: Malformed
malformed.description: Lines that could not be parsed and were skipped

matched.title: Matched
matched.description: Lines that went to a tool in the inventory

MyData.title: MyData
MyData.description: Everything the system holds about the signed-in user.

PolicyErrorResponse.title: PolicyErrorResponse
PolicyErrorResponse.description: Body of the 403 (block) and 409 (warn) answers, shaped like an OpenAI error.

store_snippets.title: Store Snippets
store_snippets.description: Keep a masked snippet of at most `snippet_chars` characters on events

tool.title: Tool
tool.description: Inventory slug or domain of the AI tool it was sent to

enforced.title: Enforced
enforced.description: False: the prompt was only observed, so it reached the tool as written. True: record it as if the gateway had been in the path and applied the policy

PromptRecord.title: PromptRecord
PromptRecord.description: One prompt from an activity log, for example an export from a browser plug-in.

data_types.title: Data Types
data_types.description: Every type valid in a policy `data` list

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: The categories a protected document can have

returned.title: Returned
returned.description: Distinct placeholders seen in the response and restored

unresolved.title: Unresolved
unresolved.description: Placeholder-like tokens that match nothing in the vault

ResponsesRequest.title: ResponsesRequest
ResponsesRequest.description:
An OpenAI Responses request. The gateway is stateless: send the whole `input` each
time, without `previous_response_id`. A field the gateway does not know is refused with
a 400 that names it.

RowSource.title: RowSource
RowSource.description: Which layer a protected-data row belongs to.

texts.title: Texts
texts.description: The same texts, in order, as the agent's model saw them

SpanView.title: SpanView
SpanView.description:
A finding in the last user message, in the coordinates of what the user typed.
`placeholder` is null for a finding that is flagged but left in place, such as a
confidentiality marker.

term.title: Term
term.description: The name to protect, 2 to 200 characters

aliases.title: Aliases
aliases.description: Other names: a list, or text split on ; or |

TermDraft.title: TermDraft
TermDraft.description:
One submitted row of a term list, with the fields of `TermIn`. Rows are validated one
by one: a bad row is reported with its number and the others are imported.

review_note.title: Review Note
review_note.description: Why discovery flagged this tool as an AI service

is_demo.title: Is Demo
is_demo.description: A fictional tool served by mock-upstream; usable in Chat

upstream_url.title: Upstream Url
upstream_url.description: Where the gateway forwards prompts for this tool

ToolUpdate.title: ToolUpdate
ToolUpdate.description: Any change marks the rating as confirmed by an analyst and clears the review flag.

needs_acknowledgement.title: Needs Acknowledgement
needs_acknowledgement.description: True for an unconfirmed warn: resend with `X-Aspida-Acknowledge-Warning: true`

upstream_messages.title: Upstream Messages
upstream_messages.description: What the AI tool saw, or would see if a warning is acknowledged

Trace.title: Trace
Trace.description:
Sent with every proxied response as the `aspida` field. It is built for the caller and
never stored, because `spans` describe the caller's own raw text.

TraceSummary.title: TraceSummary
TraceSummary.description: Sent as `aspida_summary` once the response is complete.

Usage.title: Usage
Usage.description: Model usage attributable to one request.

path.title: Path
path.description: Where in the document, for example `rules[2].when.data`
